topic: Project Northstar Week 3 interim steering decision
audience_posture: CFO and Steering Committee; skeptical, time-constrained, control-sensitive
emotional_register: measured, evidence-led, and explicit about uncertainty
format_promise: A concise, editable 16:9 board-risk deck with exactly ten claim-led slides, a visible evidence boundary on every page, and detailed notes that preserve the audit trail.

unanswered: Final client template and brand font were not supplied.

anti_format: decorative maps or icons without an evidence role
a readiness percentage that averages non-compensating gates
an ending arrow that implies automatic execution
footers so dense that source text becomes unreadable

canvas_and_grid.header_policy: Measured title and subtitle stack; body begins below the resolved header.
canvas_and_grid.column_policy: Use a board-ledger grid with stable table columns and a single dominant evidence object.

palette_role_map.blue: preferred direction and governed enterprise standard
palette_role_map.amber: open evidence or caution; never booked value

do_not_mix: Do not use image-sidebar treatments because external imagery is excluded.
Do not rotate to card grids for evidence that belongs in a ledger.
style_mix_matrix.mix_rule: Rotate only within the role-appropriate pool using northstar-week3-steering-v1; keep board-ledger framing, source lines, and semantic colors fixed.

title_page_concept.supporting_element: Advance / retain / hold direction strip and a no-authorization boundary
title_page_concept.why_this_could_only_be_this_deck: The opener separates a treasury design-direction decision from cash, execution, value, and spend authorization.

structure_strategy.primary_scaffold: Board-ledger decision memo with lab-results evidence inserts
structure_strategy.container_policy: Use open tables and ledgers for parallel fields; use cards only if content is truly modular. No slide may rely on decorative containers.
structure_strategy.reading_path: Decision → evidence → option → operating system → two tests → value discipline → falsification → owners → next decision
repeated_elements: blue enterprise standard and teal local-right encoding
structure_strategy.rhythm_break_plan: Use the option-score chart on slide 3 and the open falsification comparison on slide 8 as the two principal rhythm breaks.

design_modulation.accent_strategy: Reserve blue for the preferred direction, teal for governed local rights, and amber for open gates.
design_modulation.container_strategy: Favor open ledgers and one evidence object over card stacks.

evidence_continuity.carry_forward_rule: Every slide must preserve at least one boundary thread through title, table label, caption, or source line.

slide_applications.treatment: categorical open / blocked status and caption

readability_contract.table_density_rule: Keep editable tables at five body rows or fewer and four columns or fewer; shorten cells before reducing type.
readability_contract.whitespace_rule: One dominant evidence object should use the body region without stranded narrow content bands.
readability_contract.figure_crop_rule: No figures are planned; any future figure must be tightly cropped for its target slide.

speed_contract.renderer: pptxgenjs by default; Python tooling only where the supported workflow requires it
speed_contract.first_pass: Run workspace JSON/source validation and presentation-skill planning/preflight before rendering.
speed_contract.render_policy: Render only after the source stabilizes and required local dependencies are available; do not install dependencies during this task.
speed_contract.asset_policy: Use native editable tables and one native chart; no external or generated imagery.
speed_contract.conversion_hint: Use the presentation-skill workspace build and its supported local Office/LibreOffice path when available.

fail_on: planning errors or unresolved planning warnings
missing sources, notes, or boundary language
fewer or more than ten slides

acceptance_evidence: All workspace JSON parses and the custom source checks pass.
Exactly ten unique slide IDs and ten Markdown slide sections exist.
Every slide includes compact sources and detailed notes.
No external asset or remote URL appears in the asset plan.
A final PPTX is not accepted until it is built, rendered, and visually reviewed.

phases.purpose: Author the ten-slide narrative and durable planning files.
Run JSON, source, planning, and outline checks when dependencies permit.
Build and render through the supported workspace workflow after dependencies are available.
Inspect the contact sheet and individual slides, repair source, and rerun final readiness.
